name: io.github.Servosity/maxio-mcp
title: Maxio MCP
description: Open, local revenue-intelligence CLI for Maxio Advanced Billing  -  MRR waterfalls

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Single-secret Maxio credential, sent as the HTTP Basic username with the constant 'x' as the password. Use this or the MAXIO_USERNAME + MAXIO_PASSWORD pair.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_BASE_URL
environmentVariables.description: Full API base URL. Leave blank: the CLI builds it from MAXIO_SITE. Set it only to point at a different host.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_PASSWORD
environmentVariables.description: Set the MAXIO_PASSWORD credential for the Maxio MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_SITE
environmentVariables.description: Set the MAXIO_SITE credential for the Maxio MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_USERNAME
environmentVariables.description: Set the MAXIO_USERNAME credential for the Maxio MCP server.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_MCP_READ_ONLY
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to exactly 1 to expose only read-only tools and refuse any non-GET execute call. Leave blank to expose every tool; a call that changes Maxio still needs confirm set to true.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_NO_LOCAL_DATA
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to keep no local copy of API responses: reads go to the API, nothing is written to the local store, and sync and the revenue commands that read it refuse to run. Leave blank to keep the local store.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_MCP_HTTP_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required only when running the MCP server with --transport http. Callers must send a matching Authorization: Bearer header. Not needed for the default stdio transport.

environmentVariables.name: MAXIO_USER_AGENT
environmentVariables.description: Overrides the User-Agent the CLI sends on Maxio requests. Leave blank to use the CLI's own built-in User-Agent.

environmentVariables.name: PRINTING_PRESS_CLIENT_PROFILE
environmentVariables.description: Only for tenant-gated multi-client deployments: binds the MCP server to an existing Printing Press client profile. Leave blank for a single-tenant install.
